newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin transferred to central clinical hospital.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin transferred to central clinical hospital.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin was transferred on Friday from a specialist heart clinic to the Central Clinical Hospital, Itar-Tass news agency said, quoting Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin.
Yeltsin, 65, is recovering from a multiple heart bypass operation. Eyewitnesses near the two hospitals had seen the presidential motorcade sweeping along a closed-off thoroughfare earlier in the day.
"Now the president will be gaining strength very quickly," Tass quoted Chernomyrdin as saying. The main task of those surrounding the president was to "save him from overload".

Chernomyrdin had said on Thursday that he expected Yeltsin to leave the specialist Cardiology Research Centre within 24 hours. Chernomyrdin took over presidential powers for 23 hours while Yeltsin had his operation.
Doctors said on Thursday that the president had already left his sick bed and was walking around the hospital ward.
They said it would not take Yeltsin long to get back to work, but the specialists advised the president against going back to full-time work too soon.
